## Energy Mix

Global energy consumption by source for 138 countries from 1965 to 2023.
The dataset contains 106 columns covering absolute energy production (TWh),
percentage shares of primary energy, year-on-year growth rates, and per-capita
consumption — broken down by coal, gas, oil, hydro, nuclear, solar, wind,
biofuels, and other renewables.

This is a rich multivariate dataset well suited for PCA: principal components
typically separate fossil-fuel-heavy economies from renewables-heavy ones, and
reveal the energy transition over time.

* [Data source](https://catalog.ourworldindata.org/garden/energy/2024-06-20/energy_mix/energy_mix.parquet)
* [Our World in Data — Energy Mix](https://ourworldindata.org/energy-mix)
* Authors: Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado, Our World in Data
* Underlying data: Energy Institute — Statistical Review of World Energy (1965–2023); Vaclav Smil — Energy Transitions: Global and National Perspectives (pre-1965)
